description: 200 food-logging utterances in the owner's own voice: lazy, unpunctuated, and damaged the way Deepgram nova-3 damages real speech. Written to be the input distribution for issue #21 - the tests were consistent with the fixtures and wrong about the world. style is one of speech (messy but correctly transcribed), stt (mis-transcribed), typed (keyboard typos). hazard names what this specific phrase can break downstream.

lanes.morning: Morning — the first log of the day
lanes.shakes: Shakes, powder, and a weigh-in in the same breath
lanes.grocery: Packaged groceries — Costco, Trader Joe's, the fridge
lanes.time: Backdated — a day word and a meal word, in either order
lanes.usual: The usual — saved meals and repeats
lanes.amounts: Amounts — counts, containers, fractions, made-up units
lanes.notlogs: Not a food log at all
lanes.nasty: Nasty edges a real person still says

phrases.text: shake
phrases.hazard: Bare noun with no brand, size, or scoop count — nothing to anchor macros to unless it resolves to a saved meal.

phrases.text: um two eggs and uh some rice from last night i think thats it for now
phrases.hazard: "some rice from last night" has no weight and its "last night" may be read as a diary-date shift on a breakfast log.

phrases.text: just coffee so far like the big one from starbucks the usual
phrases.hazard: Drink identity unresolved — Venti size plus milk and syrup choices decide every macro, and "the usual" needs history lookup.

phrases.text: okay so the yogurt thing and a banana and uh also i weighed like one seventy eight this morning
phrases.hazard: Body weight is crammed into a food log with no unit; 178 must become a weight entry, not a food row with 178 grams.

phrases.text: three eggs no wait four eggs scrambled with a handful of cheddar and uh some hot sauce doesnt count right
phrases.hazard: Spoken self-correction must replace the count, not sum to seven eggs; "a handful of cheddar" has no gram estimate.

phrases.text: oatmeal with peanut butter in it like a big scoop and half a scoop of the powder the vanilla one
phrases.hazard: Two different "scoop" units in one breath — a PB spoonful versus a fractional protein-powder scoop of an unnamed brand.

phrases.text: same as always
phrases.hazard: Pure back-reference with zero items named; requires resolving his usual breakfast from history or the log is empty.

phrases.text: premier protein on the way out the door thats it im gonna eat real food when i get there
phrases.hazard: Premier Protein size and flavor unresolved (11oz vs 14oz), and the "gonna eat later" clause is future intent that must not be logged.

phrases.text: i think i ate a bowl of cereal at like four am does that go on today or yesterday cause i hadnt slept yet
phrases.hazard: 4am log straddles the calendar boundary — his subjective day versus the America/Los_Angeles date, and the question needs an answer not a row.

phrases.text: to eggs and won fair life shake the chocolate one i had it in bed
phrases.hazard: "to" and "won" are number-word homophones for 2 and 1; "fair life" must alias to Fairlife or the brand lookup fails.

phrases.text: i coast triple zero and ate almonds maybe more than ate whatever
phrases.hazard: "i coast" is Oikos mangled and "ate" is the number 8 twice; "maybe more than ate" leaves the almond count non-deterministic.

phrases.text: a big bowl of oh cost with granola on top and a la kwa after
phrases.hazard: Two mangled brands (Oikos, La Croix) plus "big bowl" with no gram weight, and granola is a second unpriced item hiding in a modifier.

phrases.text: guest bar in the car and coffee no sugar kirk land the big bag one
phrases.hazard: "guest" is Quest with no flavor picked, and "kirk land the big bag one" describes coffee beans rather than a servable portion.

phrases.text: chick filet chicken minis this morning the ate count and a large coffee
phrases.hazard: "the ate count" is an 8-piece order transcribed as a verb; needs a restaurant-item match, not generic chicken plus bread.

phrases.text: wait was one seventy seven this morning and then i had to scrambled eggs and half a bagel
phrases.hazard: weight/wait homophone can drop the body-weight reading entirely, while "to scrambled eggs" is really a count of two.

phrases.text: fah gay yogurt with honey like a spoonful and a sigh bowl thing my girlfriend made
phrases.hazard: "fah gay" is Fage and "a sigh" is acai; a girlfriend-made bowl means an unknown recipe and an unknown split portion.

phrases.text: um i just had like 8 protein shake and uh whatever was left of the rice from last night
phrases.hazard: The article "a" was heard as the digit 8, so quantity reads as eight shakes; "whatever was left" has no measurable amount.

phrases.text: the usual shake and creatine
phrases.hazard: "usual" needs a Tier-0 saved-meal hit; creatine has no macros so it becomes a 0-kcal row or is silently dropped.

phrases.text: um my shake but i only drank like half of it cause it tasted weird so half a shake i guess
phrases.hazard: Portion is 0.5 of an unknown baseline; the restated "half a shake" risks halving twice to 0.25.

phrases.text: protein shake last night around midnight i forgot to log it two scoops chocolate with fairlife and a spoon of peanut butter and a banana in the blender and also im 183 this morning
phrases.hazard: One breath yields four food rows plus a weight entry, and "last night around midnight" straddles two diary dates.

phrases.text: one scoop no wait two scoops i did two
phrases.hazard: Spoken self-correction — naive extraction sums 1+2 and logs three scoops.

phrases.text: me and her split a premier protein so half a bottle
phrases.hazard: Halving a fixed-size bottle whose label is per-container, so 0.5 must scale the package panel, not a serving.

phrases.text: shake and im 182 today
phrases.hazard: 182 must route to body weight in pounds, not become the shake's grams or calories.

phrases.text: pre workout only the powder no calories right just log it anyway

phrases.text: big scoop like a heaping one not the flat scoop it says on the tub
phrases.hazard: "Heaping" is a multiplier on the tub's serving grams with no number and no named product to look up.

phrases.text: to scoops of way protein with fair life whole milk and ate ounces of water
phrases.hazard: "to"=2, "ate"=8, "way"=whey, "fair life"=fairlife, and milk plus water both claim the liquid base.

phrases.text: i had my guest powder shake and my wait was won eighty won this morning
phrases.hazard: "guest"=Quest, "wait"=weight, "won eighty won"=181 — the number can be misread as a food quantity.

phrases.text: kirk land way vanilla to scoops in the shaker and a little a sigh packet thing
phrases.hazard: "kirk land" and "a sigh" are Kirkland and acai; the acai packet has no size, so grams are unknowable.

phrases.text: creating five grams and pre workout the blue one before the gym
phrases.hazard: "creating"=creatine at 0 kcal; "the blue one" gives no brand to match a pre-workout row.

phrases.text: premier protein caramel won bottle and i ate half of another won
phrases.hazard: "won" is one twice while "ate" is the verb, not eight — the real quantity is 1.5 bottles.

phrases.text: shake with fah gay yogurt in it and a scoop of chocolate way
phrases.hazard: "fah gay"=Fage; the yogurt amount is missing and it is blended in, so one composite row or two separate ones is undecided.

phrases.text: casey in shake before bed to scoops in water
phrases.hazard: "casey in"=casein, different macros than whey; "to"=2 and a bedtime log can land on the wrong diary date.

phrases.text: 8 scoop and a half of the chocolate one and some milk whatever was left in the jug
phrases.hazard: "8" is a misheard "a", so 1.5 scoops not 8.5; "whatever was left" gives no milk volume.

phrases.text: uh chick fil a nuggets the twelve piece and a large fry and the sauce like two of the chick fil a sauces

phrases.text: chick filet grilled chicken sammich no pickles and a lemonade i think it was the small won

phrases.hazard: 'cfa' abbreviation plus 'last nite' at an after-midnight log means the diary date shifts back a day, and 30-count split in half is 15 nuggets not 30

phrases.text: ok im reading off the receipt uh eight count grilled nuggets a market salad large diet lemonade and a cool wrap but the cool wrap was hers so dont count that one
phrases.hazard: four line items read in a row with an exclusion instruction attached only to the last one; market salad also has a dressing that is unnamed

phrases.text: venti iced brown sugar shaken espresso with oat milk and i had one of those bacon gouda egg bites no like two of them
phrases.hazard: self-correction changes egg bite count 1 to 2 but egg bites ship as a 2-pack, so 'two' may mean one package; oat milk is already the default for that drink

phrases.text: grand day caramel macchiato with skim and ate pumps of vanilla no wait for pumps
phrases.hazard: 'grand day' is grande, 'ate' and 'for' are 8 and 4 pumps at ~20 kcal each, and the corrected number comes after the wrong one

phrases.text: sbux grande cold brew w sf vanilla and a splash of heavy cream mabye 2 splashes
phrases.hazard: 'sf' means sugar free so the syrup is zero-cal, but 'splash' of heavy cream has no unit and 2 splashes could be 30 or 100 kcal

phrases.text: oh yeah i forgot yesterday like two in the morning we hit in n out i got a double double protein style and animal fries but she ate half the fries
phrases.hazard: 2am yesterday is two diary dates back from a 1am log; protein style drops the bun; animal fries are shared so the portion is 0.5

phrases.text: in and out cheese burger no onion and mustard grilled and a neopolitan shake wait it was chocolate
phrases.hazard: 'mustard grilled' is a cooking modifier not an added condiment, and the shake flavor is corrected mid-utterance so the first flavor must not become a second row

phrases.text: double double
phrases.hazard: two words, no chain named, no size or drink; could match a saved meal or a bare burger with no fries context

phrases.hazard: 'chip hotel' is Chipotle mangled; queso and chips are separately priced add-ons, and 'most of the chips' leaves an undefined fraction under 0.5 for me

phrases.text: weighed in at like one eighty two this morning and then for lunch i had a chipotle chicken burrito the whole thing with everything on it
phrases.hazard: body weight in pounds and a food share one utterance; 'everything on it' is not an ingredient list so rice, beans, salsa, cheese, sour cream all have to be assumed

phrases.text: the usual chipotle one with the double steak

phrases.text: mcdonalds like a mcchicken and a ten piece nugget and a medium fry and a diet coke thats it

phrases.text: the usual costco yogurt thing

phrases.text: like a third of the bag of trader joes dark chocolate peanut butter cups i was coding

phrases.text: won hole fair life to percent chocolate and 8 scoop of that kirk land shake mix

phrases.text: ate a guest bar and to of the oh cost cups
phrases.hazard: ate reads as eight or as the verb, to is two, and guest and oh cost are Quest and Oikos

phrases.text: half the tub of the fah gay total zero and a la kwa

phrases.text: i coast triple zero strawberry to cups no wait won cup and the other won was hers

phrases.text: a sigh bowl from the costco freezer the hole packet plus i put kirk land granola on there like a quarter cup i gues
phrases.hazard: one utterance is two rows, an acai packet and an eyeballed quarter cup of granola with no weight

phrases.text: the frozen street tacos from costco i had like ate of them there small
phrases.hazard: ate is eight or the verb, and there small is a size qualifier that changes per-taco grams

phrases.text: coupla those trader joes chicken burger patties the chili lime won and 8 whole wheat bun

phrases.text: won of them big fair life core power the 42 gram won after i lifted

phrases.text: um yesterday i had like chicken and rice for lunch and a shake after i lifted i forgot to log any of it
phrases.hazard: One day word covers two items, and "after i lifted" is a time cue with no clock, so the shake may collapse into the lunch row.

phrases.text: ok its like one am so this is for yesterday not today two eggs and toast and uh a premier protein
phrases.hazard: "yesterday" at 1am America/Los_Angeles is wall-clock minus one day; a UTC day boundary shifts the diary date two days back.

phrases.text: the day before yesterday i went to chick filet got the spicy deluxe and a large fry i dont remember what else

phrases.text: yestreday dinner was inn out double double no fries adn a diet coke

phrases.text: earlier i had a la kwa and uh nothing else really oh and a banana

phrases.text: over the weekend i mean saturday and sunday i had the same thing both days panda express two entree plate

phrases.text: the usual
